correctness.rationale: For the [24,12,8] binary extended Golay realization with the seven-term cyclic generator and parity extension, Witt S(5,8,24) octads contain each five-coordinate consecutive window, forcing an octad with at least four cyclic internal edges and pair weight <=16-4=12 for ANY ordering. The explicit displayed 24-coordinate permutation has exactly 30,118,240,234,137 octads with respectively 0,1,2,3,4 internal edges, no octad above four; pair weight for Hamming weight 8 is 16-e, while other possible Hamming weights 12,16,24 cannot yield a smaller nonzero pair weight. Independently regenerated all 2^12 codewords and the 42504 pentad-to-octad incidences and direct pair minimum 12. The universal all-permutation inequality is a design proof, not a sampled permutation search.
